objective: Run source-backed game-ready golden cases for ordinary vehicle, mecha, spacecraft/starship or carrier, fixed base, mobile base, and a nested carrier/craft or base/mecha relationship across the existing owner handoffs without duplicate identity, invented semantics or authority bleed.
acceptance: Provide golden proofs for ordinary vehicle, mecha, spacecraft/starship or carrier, fixed base, mobile base, and one nested carrier/craft or base/mecha relationship.

Each proof covers definition/configuration, live identity, crew/control where applicable, cargo/resources, operation/travel/combat participation, damage state, repair/project handoff, save/reload/reconnect and provenance.
Golden cases use source-backed or existing governed owner records; synthetic scaffolding may exercise workflow mechanics but may not become canonical content.
Save/reload/reconnect preserves stable identity, explicit relationships, provenance and owner versions without duplicating Assets.
Unknown/source-unspecified fields remain unresolved through the golden workflow and do not receive convenience defaults.
MERA engineering topology and MBES built-environment topology remain outside the golden proof except as explicit owner gaps/handoffs.
boundaries: OARC-06 is workflow proof/certification only; it does not become an operational, combat, project, resource, save/reload or ownership runtime.
No OARC-07 coverage percentage or final coverage ledger is produced here.
Installed modules are not automatically salvage outputs.
Pilot/crew/occupant identities remain separate from machine Asset identity.
Nested craft/mecha/cargo preserve separate stable Asset identities.
GPR remains independent and MRCS remains terminal completed history.
next_action: OARC-06 is completed_verified. OARC-07 is selected_not_started and requires a later OARC-specific owner Continue for governed start.
